semantics.complete: events cover the declared main-VM horizon
semantics.incomplete_lowering: no prefix tuple is consumed as complete
semantics.legacy_declared_complete: schema-v1-v7 declared horizon coverage without an enforced lowering interface
semantics.legacy_declared_unknown: schema-v1-v7 incomplete prefix was exposed through the old schedule interface

semantics.stationary_geometry_candidate: diagnostic compatibility under a stationary-parent proxy; parent motion and update order remain unresolved

semantics.exact: one point intent equals one point observation
semantics.support: one intent interval overlaps the observation
semantics.unmatched: no timed main-VM intent interval overlaps

semantics.ambiguous_endpoint_overlap: one known future changed to or from inflight
semantics.definite_known_future_overlap: one known future was inflight at both endpoints
semantics.no_known_future_overlap: none of the three known futures overlapped both endpoints

semantics.observation_build_pre_emit: bucketed by the current audit evidence count
semantics.previous_emit: bucketed by the preceding audit evidence count
